adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the refresh flow is implemented via a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and never calls the newly introduced `refreshOAuthTokens` helper. Since `refreshOAuthTokens` conditionally routes refreshes to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is set, Salesforce will not participate in the credential-sync mechanism and will continue refreshing against Salesforce directly, diverging from the new behavior applied to other integrations in this diff.
